content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I forgot my password and can’t access my dashboard.
No problem. Could you please provide your username or the email address tied to your account?
Thanks, Jane. I’ve sent a password reset link to the email we have on file. Please check your inbox and click on the link.
Got it. I clicked the link and it’s asking for my employee number.
Go ahead and enter your employee number. This is just to verify your identity.
Okay, I entered it. Now it’s prompting me to create a new password.
Great! Please choose a strong, unique password, then click the 'Submit' button to finalize the reset.
All set. I’m able to log in now—thank you for your help!
